TextEng: Summoned by the Crimson Prophet, it appears this demon wants nothing more than to rip you to shreds...
Strange magical beings, Glowstones are utilized by the sorcerers of the Sharakhan Empire to give illumination in dark areas.
Corpses reanimated through necromancy, Zombies are mindless undead that shamble about, trying to satiate the dull ache of hunger in their decaying gut.
Text: 걍령술로 되살아난 시체인, 좀비는 마음이 없는 언데드로 어기적거리며 썩어가는 내장에서 느껴지는 배고픔을 달래려고 애씁니다.

TextEng: These heavy draft animals are prized possessions that not all farmers can afford. Oxen are well suited to pulling plows and milling grain.
Text: 모든 농부들이 이 육중한 가축을 살 수 있는 것은 아닙니다. 황소는 쟁기를 끌거나 곡물을 제분하는데 아주 적합합니다.

TextEng: The last of the Dy'nesh line, this raven-haired elven beauty bears her family's ability to speak with the dead. It is a gift bestowed upon them by the goddess Akhana but jealously reviled by the priesthood. Now she serves the Emperor, finding safety in his shadow.
As quiet as he is loyal, this brooding young ranger bears unknown burdens upon his shoulders. The Emperor's eyes and ears within the shadows, he misses little and divulges less.

Stern in countenance and stout of heart, this former slave now serves as the Emperor's secret commander in the field. Part warrior, part ambassador, and part agent of vengeance, he protects the Empire from itself.

Leaving behind a string of gambling debts at every port of call, it is a wonder that this compulsive little halfling has time to serve the Emperor at all. But trust is won across a table's winnings and many a secret gleaned. Perhaps he's a better gambler than he lets on.
Statue of King Garian the Wise
Typically docile in nature, these wild, skittish herbivores gather in small groupings that scatter quickly when threatened.
Text: 전형적으로 온순한 이 야생의 겁많은 초식 동물은 작은 무리를 지어 모이며 위협을 받으면 재빨리 흩어집니다.

TextEng: Wraiths are incorporeal creatures born of evil and darkness. They despise all living things, as well as the light that nurtures them.
Text: 망령은 악과 암흑에서 태어난 형체가 없는 생명체 입니다. 이들은 모든 생명체를 경멸하고, 생명체를 기르는 빛 또한 경멸합니다.
